title: Elderly Family Members Outside Porch, 1941 Texas B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 7-22-41 L. to R. Clacey Ed, Jas. M. McClure J. Frank " Ema, Edgar M. " " Prentice " Prentice YOUR ENTIRE ROLL DEVELOPED AND JUMBO PRINT 6 or 8 Exposure Roll STUDER PHOTO CO. AUTHORIZED DEALER 882
description: An outdoor group portrait taken on July 22, 1941, showing six family members posed outside beside the wooden porch of a house. The men are dressed in a mix of everyday and formal workwear: one in denim bib overalls holding spectacles or a cigar, others in dress shirts and neckties, and one in a light suit jacket. The women wear typical late Great Depression and early 1940s cotton day dresses. The back carries an authorized dealer stamp from the prominent Texas-based Studer Photo Co. Taken just months before the United States entered World War II, the photograph captures a peaceful moment of domestic family life in rural or small-town America.
